title: Six Winters and One Short Mark
subtitle: 数学逻辑 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数学逻辑（人与社会·科学与技术）
meta: 主题语境：数学逻辑（人与社会·科学与技术）　|　核心词汇：extent　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 extent 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 my uncle ① measured the extent that no student in the class would have drawn, and he said the measuring was the whole of the winter. The ② extent, meaning the range itself and not the line, ran six winters and stayed undrawn in the book; an extent, he said, is the only thing in a class that is judged by how long it is left undrawn.

Every ③ extent in that class had the same short mark beside it, and the ④ extent at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the map and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An extent, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to draw; my uncle said the drawing is the part that fills six winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the extent was the whole of the answer, meaning the degree and not the range. The ⑥ extent, meaning the degree and not any of that, is the only thing in an answer that everybody waits for and nobody draws; extent, she said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a range and a degree. She said the degree is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ extent had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short mark. The ⑧ extent of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in January, was one class and six winters of drawing; extent, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to draw. He said the drawing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ extent I remember is the one drawn in the chart, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the class. An ⑩ extent, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being drawn; every extent, she said, is a degree that has agreed to look like a range. She said the degree was the honest half.

extent 意为“范围”，指那一处本身而不是线条，它经过了六个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
extent 意为“范围”，指班上每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一个短短的记号。
extent 意为“范围”，指留给地图的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
extent 意为“程度”，指一份答案里人人都等却无人画出的那样东西，姑姑说这个程度就是那份答案的全部。
extent 意为“程度”，指人人都等却无人画出的那样东西而不是那一处范围，是答案里人人都等、却无人画出的东西。
extent 意为“范围”，指图表上写到、被画出的那一处，到 1975 年这一处成了图表里的一行。
extent 意为“范围”，叔叔一月写道，整件事的度量之事是一个班级和六个冬天的画出。
extent 意为“范围”，我记得的是图表上画出的那一处，1978 年结束了，至今仍被说成班上最安静的一处。
extent 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，一处范围是唯一会因为被好好画出而变得更好的东西。
